hints.title: Identical Boundary Flowers
hints.text: A garden must begin and end with flowers sharing the exact same beauty value.

hints.title: Include Positive Internal Flowers
hints.text: Any internal flower with positive beauty should be retained, while negative internal flowers should be excluded.

hints.title: First and Last Occurrence Lookup
hints.text: For each distinct flower beauty value, the maximum range is bounded by its first occurrence and current occurrence.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of flowers array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all pairs of identical flowers naively takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix sums of positive values plus first occurrence map evaluates optimal ranges in O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes that expanding interval between identical boundary values strictly increases positive sum.

solutions.approach: Positive prefix sums with first occurrence boundary hashing
